why: New sideloadable Android WebView probe under tools/phone-probe/ plus a workflow that builds its debug APK as an artifact (phase 1a of docs/integrations/breakout-phone-executor-DESIGN.md). Read-only app: no order, no tap on the Breakout page, no stored credential; no src/, config/, VM or order-path change. The Gradle, manifest and fixture-HTML paths are outside the guard's Tier-1 surface, so a human lands it after the APK has been confirmed on the phone.
